exposure: Adherence to guidelines (ACOG, local hospital, ACCP, international)
Type of thromboprophylaxis used by OBGYN
cohort: 209 practicing obstetricians and gynecologists (OBGYN) who were fellows of the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG)
finding: Awareness of thromboembolism risk around delivery is high among OBGYNs, with most routinely using some form of thromboprophylaxis and referencing guidelines, primarily ACOG.
